none was a complete book at once.","anchor":"فإنها لم ينزل شيء منها جملة واحدة وإنما كانت وحيا مفرقا","mentions":[]},{"verses":["25:32"],"words":["لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ"],"type":"reports","speaker":"قيل","stance":"reports","claim":"An alternative report says Jews or Christians made the objection.","anchor":"وقيل : إن قائل هذا اليهود أو النصارى","mentions":[]},{"verses":["25:32"],"words":["جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"If Jews or Christians said this, it was slander, since they knew their own Torah, Gospel, and Psalms were revealed piecemeal.","anchor":"لأنهم يعلمون أنه لم تنزل التوراة والإنجيل والزبور إلا مفرقة","mentions":[]},{"verses":["25:32"],"words":["ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ"],"type":"interpretation","speaker":"author","stance":"rejects","claim":"He dismisses commentators’ effort to explain the difference by contrasting Muhammad’s illiteracy with earlier prophets: none of their books descended as a complete volume.","anchor":"فإن تلك الكتب لم تنزل أسفارا تامة قط","mentions":[]},{"verses":["25:32"],"words":["نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ"],"type":"meaning","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"Here نزل means أنزل and, given ‘all at once,’ does not signal the intensive or repeated sense of the verb form.","anchor":"و { نزل } هنا مرادف أنزل وليس فيه إيذان بما يدل عليه التفعيل من التكثير","mentions":[]},{"verses":["25:32"],"words":["كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ"],"type":"links","speaker":"author","stance":"holds","claim":"The response turns from the objectors to the Prophet, explaining the wisdom of gradual revelation and expressing God’s favor in strengthening and easing matters for him.","anchor":"فهو كلام مستأنف فيه رد لما أرادوه من قولهم : { لولا نزل عليه القرآن جملة واحدة }","mentions":[]}]}
